resources.string: Modular Most Used
Most Used

Most Used adds a starred section to Modular Home. Pin apps in Modular to keep them at the top in your chosen order. With Usage Access, recent foreground time also supplies suggestions. Set Recent days and Suggested apps in Modular settings, then select Use on Home.
Usage access is on. Android has foreground history from the past 7 days.
Usage access is off for Most Used. Saved pins still appear in the starred section; enable access for suggestions.

If Android says Usage Access is controlled by a restricted setting, open App info for Modular Most Used, tap the three-dot menu, and choose Allow restricted settings. Then return here and open Usage Access settings. This choice is available only if Android offers it for this app.

Add usage suggestions?
Most Used can suggest apps from foreground time reported by Android. This needs Usage Access for the Most Used app. Saved pins work without it. You can choose later in this screen.
